settings.title: Brazil
settings.region: Minas Gerais and Rio Grande do Sul
settings.text: The pegmatites of Minas Gerais yield clear quartz, and the basalt geodes of Rio Grande do Sul are lined with amethyst.

settings.title: Pakistan
settings.text: High-altitude pegmatites in the Shigar Valley and Nagar produce aquamarine, often growing alongside fluorite.

settings.title: Libyan Desert
settings.text: Natural silica glass about 29 million years old, found scattered between the dunes of the Great Sand Sea near the border of Libya and Egypt.

settings.title: Morocco
settings.text: The old lead mines at Mibladen are the classic source of bright red, hexagonal vanadinite crystals.

settings.title: India
settings.text: Two feldspars known for their play of light: moonstone with its soft blue sheen and labradorite with its flash of colour.
